# ZUS Coffee Ngupi @ Restoran Pak Haji Ali

> Ice-cold Malaysian White Coffee and Chocolate Coffee for RM3.90 per cup. Served cold only. Fixed sweetness. Located in Subang Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia.

## Menu & Prices
- [White Coffee](https://zuscoffee.github.io/zuscoffee/): RM3.90. Smooth, creamy Malaysian-style white coffee. Served ice-cold.
- [Chocolate Coffee](https://zuscoffee.github.io/zuscoffee/): RM3.90. Rich chocolate blended with smooth coffee. Served ice-cold.
- [Full Menu Guide](https://zuscoffee.github.io/zuscoffee/blog/zus-coffee-ngupi-menu-prices.html): Detailed breakdown of the 2026 menu, prices, and ordering options.

## Blog & Guides
- [Best ZUS Coffee Ngupi Outlet in Malaysia](https://zuscoffee.github.io/zuscoffee/blog/best-zus-coffee-ngupi-outlet-malaysia.html): Why the Subang Jaya outlet stands out from the rest.

## Key Facts
- **Price:** RM3.90 per cup (flat price, no hidden charges)
- **Drinks:** White Coffee, Chocolate Coffee
- **Served:** Ice-cold only (no hot drinks)
- **Sweetness:** Fixed (no customisation)
- **Location:** Restoran Pak Haji Ali, Subang Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia
- **Payment:** Cash, QR Pay, Online Transfer
